tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Deepest layer: page and app background, terminal wells, map base.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Data panels, cards and side menus that sit on ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px panel borders, dividers, idle control outlines.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Decorative only: minor ticks, grid levels, ghost outlines. Never text.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and labels on ground, panel and charcoal.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, mono IDs, captions (6:1 on panel).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: The one accent: interactive, selected, live data strokes, lock circles, focus.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a selected or hovered segment; radar area.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Terrain contours and the alternate map theme. Not for UI state.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Attention: warnings, approval needed, dirty worktree, anomaly markers.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success lines in terminals and passed checks. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: charcoal-950
tokens.usage: Deepest charcoal: recessed wells inside charcoal chrome.

tokens.name: charcoal-900
tokens.usage: Charcoal ground for full-screen formal views (lock screen, home canvas).

tokens.name: charcoal-800
tokens.usage: Lower plate of the matte-metal surface; pressed state on charcoal.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Architect charcoal, the formal neutral: app frame, header bar, page chrome, approval dialogs.

tokens.name: charcoal-600
tokens.usage: Raised plate and hover on charcoal chrome; dividers inside charcoal.

tokens.name: charcoal-sheen
tokens.usage: 1px top edge of matte-metal plates and engraved labels. Never body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tick gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel header and footer padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; overlay stage inset.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Menu rails, tabs' bottom edge, HUD rules.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panels and overlays; never larger.
